name: fiducial-dot
title: Fiducial copper dot
summary: A fiducial's bare copper dot: a copper disc (diameter, thickness) on the seating plane.
provenance: Original work, authored through SolidCraft's commands by `cargo test -p sparksmith-solidcraft --test author_parts -- --ignored` (`author_parts/families.rs`, `author_fiducial`): a disc of the fiducial's copper diameter and 1 oz outer copper (35 µm, IPC-4562's nominal 34.8 µm rounded).
